role: computable map from formula codes to L-sentences reducing validity to finite satisfiability
notes: Local name of the reduction of Boerger-Graedel-Gurevich 1997, Exercise 2.1.33 (p. 36); type: function from codes in FO to codes of sentences.

role: universal closure of a formula (free variables in order of first occurrence)
notes: Formula-to-sentence operator; dual of the existential closure varphi^exists of annex:p02-w02-p02-036-fmp.

role: numerical code of a formula under the fixed effective coding
notes: Same meaning as the corner-quote code notation already used in P1 (languages-logical-systems-and-levels-of-w02-p01-004).

role: semi-conservative reduction between recursive formula classes
notes: Source notation f of Boerger-Graedel-Gurevich 1997, Def. 2.1.38 (p. 37); type: recursive function X -> Y on codes.

role: set of binary numerals accepted by the decoded machine M_e (empty for invalid e)
notes: Local index notation for c.e. sets built on the machine codes V and M_e of def:p02-w02-p02-036-halting; type: number -> subset of N. Source uses W_i for r.e. sets with Goedel numbers (BGG 1997 p. 37).

role: witness of effective inseparability (total computable N^2 -> N)
notes: Source calls it f (BGG 1997 p. 37); renamed p locally because f names the semi-conservative reduction in this section.

role: codes e in V whose machine rejects bin(e)
notes: Local; set of numbers.

role: codes e in V whose machine accepts bin(e)
notes: Local; set of numbers.

role: conservative reduction from FO to X built in the proof of Gurevich's theorem
notes: Local; recursive function FO -> X. Also used (with a different local meaning, a given conservative reduction) in the paragraph before sec:p02-w02b-p02-031-gurevich.

role: computably enumerable set of codes fed to the fixed-point item
notes: Local; subset of N.

role: finite state set of a two-register machine program (contains 0 and the stop states 1 and 2)
notes: Local; finite subset of N. Source writes states i = 0..r (BGG 1997 p. 28).

role: addition instruction of a two-register machine (state i adds 1 to register r and goes to j)
notes: Source notation I_i = (i,r,j) (BGG 1997 pp. 28-29); triple of numbers.

role: subtraction instruction of a two-register machine (zero test on register r: go to j if empty; else subtract 1 and go to k)
notes: Source notation I_i = (i,r,j,k) (BGG 1997 p. 29); quadruple of numbers.

role: reachability of configuration D in the computation of M from C
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 p. 28); binary relation on configurations.

role: atom K_iab describing a register-machine configuration
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 p. 28); atomic formula.

role: binary predicate symbol for configurations in state i
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 p. 28); binary relation symbol. Unrelated to the self-application set K of P4.

role: auxiliary binary predicate symbols deriving the start atom (0;m;0)
notes: Local; not in the source, which writes the start atom with the term 0^(m).

role: quantifier-free Krom-Horn matrix of the register-machine reduction formulas
notes: Local; formula in the variables u,x,v,y. Source writes alpha for the matrix of psi_M (BGG 1997 p. 28).

role: prenex sentence with prefix exists-forall-exists-forall and matrix alpha_{M,m}
notes: Source notation beta_{M,prec,C,D} with C = (0,m,0), D = (1,0,0) (BGG 1997 p. 36).

role: prenex sentence with prefix forall-exists-exists-forall and matrix alpha_{M,m}
notes: Local name for the second class of Exercise 2.1.37 (BGG 1997 p. 37).

role: register-machine reduction sentence beta_{M,prec,0} of Exercise 2.1.32
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 p. 36).

role: relativized infinity axiom for a two-register machine
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 p. 36). Same glyph as the Turing-machine relativized axiom of def:p02-w02-p02-036-refined; the meaning is fixed by the type of M (register machine here).

role: two-register machine program simulating the Turing machine T
notes: Local; M^0_T is the variant started from (0;0;0).

role: start content of register 1 for input word w
notes: Local; number 3^{rho_0(w)}.

role: logic machine (two-register program) halting in (1;0;0) on unsatisfiable and in (2;0;0) on finitely satisfiable formulas
notes: Source calls it the logic machine M (BGG 1997 p. 36).

role: register encoding of a formula psi; C(psi) = (0;m(psi);0)
notes: Source notation m(psi) and C(psi) (BGG 1997 pp. 29 and 36).

role: set of formulas psi with C(psi) =>_M (i;0;0)
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 p. 36).

role: conservative reduction from FO into the forall-exists-exists-forall Krom-Horn class
notes: Local. g (without +) is the source's g(psi) (BGG 1997 p. 36), scoped to thm:p02-w02b-p02-031-ex-2-1-34.

role: class of prenex sentences without equality and function symbols with quantifier prefix w
notes: Short form of the prefix-vocabulary classes of BGG 1997 Def. 1.3.1 (p. 8).

role: class of prenex formulas with a conjunction of Krom clauses as matrix
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 Def. 2.1.14 p. 27).

role: class of prenex formulas with a conjunction of Horn clauses as matrix
notes: Source notation (BGG 1997 Def. 2.1.14 p. 27).
